messages:
maya: Quick FYI, found inconsistent field names in the API ref for POST /chat.stream. JS examples use `speaker` instead of `role`. I opened a tiny PR to fix examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/438

luis: Good catch. If we keep `speaker` in examples, TypeScript clients will reject payloads because schema expects `role` with enum values. Also saw a double-encoded curl sample.

irene: Streaming example also shows `delta: {content: '...'}` only. In practice, the first delta chunk can include `role: 'assistant'`. We should allow an optional `role` in the streaming delta schema and document that behavior.

sam: Proposed action: (1) update JS/Python/Go snippets to use `role`, (2) fix curl to pass raw JSON (not stringified JSON inside JSON), (3) add a streaming note and tiny migration blurb for older clients. I can push follow-ups.

maya: I swapped `speaker` -> `role` in the JS and Python snippets and updated the curl sample in the PR. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ff9a7b2

luis: Suggested curl snippet (simpler, avoids nested quoting):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/chat.stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rwd-chat-1",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]
  }'

irene: I'll open a small PR for the Go example. It currently has `type Message struct { Speaker string }` which should be `Role string` with comment listing allowed values.

docbot: PRs created: docs#438 by maya, docs#439 by irene. Docs CI started and will run linters and snippet checks.

maya: CI for docs#438 passed, merging. I'll add a short changelog entry about the example fixes and streaming delta clarification.

sam: After merge I'll update the migration guide to call out older SDKs that looked for `speaker` and include a one-line patch for quick fixes.

luis: Also add a small note in the API ref about "first streaming chunk may include role" so readers don't assume content-only deltas.

maya: Great, thanks everyone. Close the loop once the Go PR merges and we verify generated SDK examples are updated.
